meta.task: cross-PRB per-UE ZF rate swap, first replay (claude_brief.md)
meta.command: (cwd = project root) OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python -B "studies/Dynamic to minimize the fronthaul load/Validation/cross_prb_zf/claude_replay.py"
meta.threshold: ONE function feasible(p, cap) for baseline and candidates: p_j = sum_u |pinv(H_S)_ju|^2 * noise*(2**rate_u - 1) on the archived mask key[b, m]; feasible <=> max_j p_j <= 10 mW * (1 + 1e-9) and sum_j p_j <= cap_b * (1 + 1e-9). Baseline m*_b = min m feasible with rate_u = r_b for all u and cap = inf; cap_b = sum_j p_j at m*_b; rerun with cap_b and d = 0 asserted to return m*_b.
meta.swap: per matched PRB pair (i, j): one UE pair (u < v) and d; rate[i, u] += d, rate[i, v] -= d, rate[j, u] -= d, rate[j, v] += d; d in {0} U {+-min(r_i, r_j) f, f in 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4}; objective: min sum over 4 PRBs of active antennas (RU-PRB); ties -> d = 0, smaller |d|, first matching
meta.load_metric: 7-1 fixed-width antenna IQ: load proportional to RU-PRB count (K = 1: active antennas summed over PRBs)
meta.statistics: per-drop paired values (4 PRBs summed within a drop), mean and 95% Student-t interval over drops
meta.limitations: masks restricted to the archived equal-rate winners key[b, m] (as specified), so the candidate search is conservative; perfect CSI, flat i.i.d. per-PRB channel, no MCS quantisation
meta.not_done: multipath frequency-correlated channel, estimated CSI, true-channel SINR under estimated-CSI W, same-MCS transport block CRC (next public check in the brief)
